name: gizza-ai/spline-smoother
summary: Fit cubic smoothing splines to noisy numeric series.

tool.description: Fit a cubic smoothing spline to a noisy numeric series. Paste one y value per row, x,y rows, or JSON data; choose automatic GCV/CV smoothing, a p value, a raw lambda, or a target effective degrees of freedom. Returns JSON, CSV, or an SVG chart with fitted values, residuals, optional predictions, resampled curve points, and optional piecewise cubic coefficients.

coefficients.description: Include natural-cubic piece coefficients for each interval in JSON/CSV output. Default false.

criterion.description: Score used by mode=auto: generalized cross-validation (gcv) or exact leave-one-out cross-validation (cv). Default gcv.

df.description: Target effective degrees of freedom for mode=df. Must be between 2 and the number of distinct x values. Default 5.

input.description: Numeric series to smooth. Accepts one y value per row, x,y rows with an optional header, a one-line y list, a JSON array of numbers, JSON [x,y] pairs, or JSON objects with x and y.

lambda.description: Raw non-negative smoothing penalty λ for mode=lambda, in the input x units. Default 1.

mode.description: How to choose the smoothing penalty: auto selects by criterion, smoothing uses p in [0,1], lambda uses a raw penalty, and df targets effective degrees of freedom.

output.description: Output format: JSON report, CSV tables, or a self-contained SVG chart. Default json.

predict_at.description: Optional x values where the fitted spline should be evaluated, separated by commas, spaces, tabs, or semicolons.

resample.description: Number of evenly spaced fitted-curve samples to include. 0 disables the curve; values above 0 must be at least 2. Default 0.

smoothing.description: Scale-free smoothing p for mode=smoothing. 0 gives the weighted least-squares straight line; 1 interpolates the distinct input points. Default 0.99.

weights.description: Optional positive weights, one per original input point, separated by commas, spaces, tabs, or semicolons. Leave empty for equal weights.
